evidence.description: REQ-S3 implemented as plist.exists() AND launchctl_print_rc == 0 (BOTH-AND, not OR).
test_installed_requires_both_disk_and_rc_zero verifies all three permutations (rc=0+no plist=False, plist+rc=1=False, BOTH=True).
REQ-S1 existing keys (source, task, funding, earn_usdc, cost_usdc, jpy_earned, applied_total, core, wake, note) retained verbatim + REQ-S2 proactive_loop added.
REQ-I3 graceful defaults when observer subprocess fails.
EDGE-E2 catch is narrow: (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError, OSError) — NOT bare Exception. Manifest constraint #3 satisfied.
Type-guards ts (isinstance int/float) before int() cast — prevents crash on malformed but valid-JSON ts.
Observer invoked with `|| echo '{}'` fallback — observer subprocess failure cannot crash the shim, preserving status JSON emission.
PURE helper isolated in lib/; CLI entrypoint cleanly separated under _cli().

Existing gig-cli.sh invocations preserved verbatim (idempotent start + --status read); no new tmux operations added. Manifest constraint #4: grep for tmux kill / --restart / --stop / --kill in run.sh = 0 hits (verified via Grep).
PROP-I2 static grep test enforces the no-tmux-kill invariant.
Pure core: file-stat-in / dict-out; launchctl rc injected as parameter, not called inside the pure function — purity boundary respected.
8 unit tests cover PROP-S2/S3/S4/S5/I3/E2/E5 + EDGE-E3; cross-platform (no Darwin-only deps in pure tests).
REQ-D1/D2 enforced via static grep for osascript/terminal-notifier/telegram/slack/twilio/sudo/SecKeychain/find-generic-password across both shim sources.
